Bob just needed fuel ⛽🐜 …the cashier heard something else 💨😂

"I have gas" = there's air coming out of you.
At a petrol station say: "I need petrol" (UK) or "I need gas" (US).

Tag a friend who would say it like Bob 👇 Save it for your trip 📌
